answer: An applicant who owns a pigment, owes a haven and outlasted a vine is an agent; an applicant holding only the first two is a farm in a hurry. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. Clean grading for 10 days is the only road to a refund, so the farm's 114202 POA earns nothing in the meantime. Where a farm sees a gap, Falconer gyrfalcon proof flown at the mews sees a record, and the record says each gyrfalcon is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record.
